sloka: सदृशं यत्तु काले ऽस्मिन् कर्तुं स्निग्धेन बन्धुना ।शत्रूणां कदनं पश्य क्रियमाणं मया रणे ।। ६.६३.३३ ।।
transliteration: sadṛśaṁ yattu kāle 'smin kartuṁ snigdhena bandhunā ।śatrūṇāṁ kadanaṁ paśya kriyamāṇaṁ mayā raṇe ।। 6.63.33 ।।

translations.english: "O king! I will give you good advice in all circumstances being a relation. Salutary advice has been given to you out of brotherly affection."
